Task #1020: Follow a board setting written late

## Goal

Make the issue pane and the heartbeat read the board the project's settings name, even when a process started before the setting was written, as the owner asked: "Fix the ordering bug in which the Mod and heartbeat read GitHub issues or local files" (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1019).

- **Settings read at each call**: `teamwork/lib/board.py` and `landing.py` pick their adapter at each use, from `TEAMWORK_BOARD` / `TEAMWORK_LANDING` in the environment, else from the `env` of the project's `.claude/settings.local.json`, then `settings.json`, in the current git root, then the main checkout (a worktree has no local settings). This is fix option (b) of #1019; option (a), a manager restart by Succession, is set aside, since it fixes only the manager's processes and only when the manager remembers it.
- **Heartbeat follows a change**: `teamwork/monitors/print-team-gaps.py`, seeing the board or landing change, drops its last read and touches the signal file, so the issue pane reads the board again too.
- **Plain output**: the board read failure names the board kind (`list-issue-board.py`); the pane says "No board read yet." before a read worked and "The board has no open issues." after; `monitors.json` no longer calls the heartbeat GitHub-only.
- **Manager step**: `kick-off/references/manager.md` step 1 no longer asks to export the pick in the shell, since every script reads the settings file.
- **Kept**: the team and landing scenarios still pass, and the pane still builds; the change's judge runs them, since they pass on base too.
- **Not here**: a setting changed while the environment variable is set (the environment wins, as in Claude Code); the session, agent ports.
- Builds on #984 (board choice at manager start, https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/pull/985), #933 (git landing) and #862 (ports).
- Files: new `teamwork/lib/port_setting.py`, `teamwork/lib/board.py`, `teamwork/lib/landing.py`, `teamwork/monitors/print-team-gaps.py`, `teamwork/monitors/monitors.json`, `teamwork/hooks/list-issue-board.py`, `teamwork/hooks/issue-pane.tsx`, `teamwork/types/index.d.ts`, `teamwork/skills/kick-off/references/manager.md`, new `teamwork/skills/kick-off/fixtures/replay-board-setting.py`, new `teamwork/hooks/fixtures/render-empty-pane.ts`.

3. [check] **heartbeat follows a late setting**: `python3 teamwork/skills/kick-off/fixtures/replay-board-setting.py 2>&1 | grep -c '^ok late-setting$'` prints `1`, the heartbeat then routing the files board's backlog, never routed before; on base `0`.
4. [check] **worktree reads main settings**: `python3 teamwork/skills/kick-off/fixtures/replay-board-setting.py 2>&1 | grep -c '^ok worktree$'` prints `1`; on base `0`.

6. [check] **failure names the board**: `python3 teamwork/skills/kick-off/fixtures/replay-board-setting.py 2>&1 | grep -c '^ok failure-names-board$'` prints `1`; on base `0`.
